name: Scary Night Simulator
summary:
Creak… went the floorboards. A spooky doll girl is after you in this creepy mansion!
You're trapped inside a dollhouse haunted by a demonic doll girl. Can you survive five nights and escape?

Explore the creepy rooms, find a hammer and keys, and solve puzzles to get out! This is one scary adventure you won't forget.
Survive five nights of terror as these seemingly innocent figures come to life with evil intent. Explore the dark corners of this unsettling place and try to escape before you become another toy
